propositions: Default fsck and compact-all scans visit only active (non-archived) tickets, using the .archived marker + net-archival confirmation as the fast-path decision
Archive operation folds the ticket inline (terminal fold with threshold=0) immediately before writing the ARCHIVED event, ensuring no unfolded events remain in archived tickets
Both commands support an explicit --include-archived flag to restore full-store walks, reusing the same semantics as ticket list
Reverted-archive tickets (stale marker but no net-archived state) are still visited by default via event-name confirmation, not marker alone
The shared _ticket_dirs iterator in fsck_repair provides the active-only default with configurable inclusion, threading through fsck_scan loops, fsck --repair, and compact._scan_snapshot_state
Legacy archived-but-unfolded tickets (from pre-change builds) are folded only by compact-all --include-archived, while default scopes skip them as non-visited
